描述_EN: the term cizhou encapsulates a range of wares made in several regions of northern china, often consisting of a stoneware body decorated with a bold design. ceramic pillows were an important item in the kilns producing cizhou wares, and were made for both funerary use and as a neck support for the living. this pillow is an example of cizhou ware, a type of ceramic made in the northern part of china during the jin dynasty (1115-1234). the stoneware body of this piece has been glazed in a modified version of the sancai three-colour scheme of the tang dynasty, known as song sancai.
描述_ZN: 术语 "Cizhou "概括了中国北方几个地区制造的一系列器物，通常由一个石器主体装饰着大胆的设计。 陶瓷枕头是窑厂生产的重要物品，既可用于葬礼，也可作为生活中的颈部支撑。 这个枕头是贵州器的一个例子，贵州器是中国北方地区在金代（1115-1234）时制造的一种陶瓷。 这件作品的石器主体已经在唐代三彩的改良版中上了釉，被称为宋三彩。
